ALCHEMIST-ACCESSIBILITY.title: Accessibility
ALCHEMIST-ANALYTICS.title: Analytics
ALCHEMIST-ANALYTICS_ENABLED.hover.desc: Sends anonymous Alchemist run results (deck, relics, card picks, floor reached) to help balance the character. Only applies when the game's own Upload Data setting is on. Never includes your name or Steam ID.
ALCHEMIST-ANALYTICS_ENABLED.title: Share Anonymous Run Analytics
ALCHEMIST-ANALYTICS_OFF.body:
Your runs will not be shared. You can still see the results from other players at [url][gold]alchemist.fyi[/gold][/url].

You can change this at any time in the mod's settings.
ALCHEMIST-ANALYTICS_ON.body:
Your anonymous run data will help balance The Alchemist. See the results from every player at [url][gold]alchemist.fyi[/gold][/url].

You can change this at any time in the mod's settings.
ALCHEMIST-ANALYTICS_PROMPT.body:
Would you like to share anonymous run data to help balance The Alchemist?

This includes your Ascension, card picks, final deck and relics, fights, events, and shop choices.

It never includes your name or Steam account.
ALCHEMIST-ANTITOXIN_BAR_COLOR.hover.desc: The color of the Antitoxin bar under your health bar. The green Poison segment keeps its color.
ALCHEMIST-ANTITOXIN_BAR_COLOR.title: Antitoxin Bar Color
ALCHEMIST-APPEARANCE.title: Appearance
ALCHEMIST-BIG_HEAD_MODE.hover.desc: Makes the Alchemist's head much bigger. That's it. Allies won't see your big head.
ALCHEMIST-BIG_HEAD_MODE.title: BIG Head
ALCHEMIST-BIG_HEAD_SIZE.hover.desc: How big the head gets, compared to its normal size.
ALCHEMIST-BIG_HEAD_SIZE.title: Head Size
ALCHEMIST-BRANCH_MISMATCH.body:
This version of The Alchemist was built for a different version of Slay the Spire 2. Some things will not work correctly. 

You are on the [gold]{currentBranch}[/gold] branch. Subscribe to the matching Workshop item and unsubscribe from this one.
ALCHEMIST-COMPATIBILITY.title: Compatibility
ALCHEMIST-ENABLE_EPOCHS.hover.desc: Adds the Alchemist's 7-chapter story to the Timeline, unlocking cards, relics, and potions as you play. Turn off to unlock everything now; turning it back on restores your progress. Always on in multiplayer.
ALCHEMIST-ENABLE_EPOCHS.title: Enable Timeline Epochs
ALCHEMIST-HERO_CARDS_WITHOUT_EXPANSION.h: Offers the 9 Alchemist cards made for The Hero Expansion without that mod installed. Broken Blade and Mysterious Flashlight still need the mod. In multiplayer, they only appear when every player has the mod.
ALCHEMIST-HERO_CARDS_WITHOUT_EXPANSION.t: Hero Expansion Cards Without the Mod
ALCHEMIST-KEEP_POOLS_SEPARATE.hover.desc: Keeps Alchemist cards out of runs without an Alchemist, such as other characters' Kaleidoscope rewards. Always on in multiplayer.
ALCHEMIST-KEEP_POOLS_SEPARATE.title: Separate Card Pool
ALCHEMIST-POISON_FORECAST_COLOR.hover.de: The color of the Poison damage forecast number beside the Antitoxin bar.
ALCHEMIST-POISON_FORECAST_COLOR.title: Poison Damage Forecast Color
